Package org.geysermc.paletter

Class PaletteLayer

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.PaletteLayer
public final class PaletteLayer extends Object
A patch on top of a palette: custom items and blocks, changes to vanilla items, creative inventory edits, tags. Content only, fallbacks and creative ordering are policy of the Paletter. Layers are immutable and independent of protocol versions; the same layer is compiled against every version.

Palettes are built by stacking layers, so ownership can be split. For example:

  1. a geyser layer with Geyser's own fixes and custom items, compiled once per version and shared;
  2. an extensions layer with custom items and blocks of extensions, also shared;
  3. a per-session layer, e.g. content of the server the player is on, applied with Palette.extend(org.geysermc.paletter.PaletteLayer).
A later layer sees everything earlier layers did. Definitions untouched by a layer are shared with the palette it extends, so the per-session palette costs little and its definitions stay == to the shared ones. Adding custom blocks in a layer does re-number block states in BlockNetworkIds.SEQUENTIAL palettes, since the client sorts its palette by name hash. Canonical ids never change: custom content is appended.
Since:
1.0.0
